# exportSvgPagesAsync

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Renders every laid-out page of a document to a standalone SVG string.

This runs the same layout pipeline as PDF output (via `SvgRenderPipeline`), after preloading embedded fonts and decoding images exactly as the PDF async path does, so the SVG page count and layout match the generated PDF.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
exportSvgPagesAsync(document: Document, options?: SvgPageExportOptions): Promise<string[]>
```
